subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic-native compaction be exposed as provider-owned model/run parameters, as part of the existing compaction provider seam, or as a broader Anthropic context-management API surface?
rationale: The missing work crosses public config, provider request payloads, streaming/session-state semantics, and a broader open Anthropic context-management request, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape alone.

options.title: Provider-owned opt-in params
options.body: Add Anthropic-specific opt-in model/run parameters and docs while keeping local and pluggable compaction behavior unchanged by default.

options.title: Compaction provider integration
options.body: Route Anthropic native compaction through the existing compaction provider selection model, accepting the risk that the provider registry grows beyond summarization backends.

options.title: Fold into broader context management
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54041 to settle headers, memory/context editing, and security boundaries together before this focused compaction implementation lands.

recommendation.title: Provider-owned opt-in params
recommendation.body: Add Anthropic-specific opt-in model/run parameters and docs while keeping local and pluggable compaction behavior unchanged by default.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history across the OpenAI server-side compaction precedent, Anthropic stream-wrapper ownership, and prior review context for this exact issue.
